basic.name: Sacred Sweep
basic.description: Sweep the area with sacred power, dealing 40~~0.04~~ damage to enemies and an additional 160~~0.04~~ damage to enemies caught in the center.

basic.name: Ray of Heaven
basic.description: Consume Auriel's stored energy and heal allied Heroes in the area for the amount of energy consumed.

basic.name: Detainment Strike
basic.description: Deal 55~~0.04~~ damage to the first enemy Hero hit and knock them back. If they collide with terrain, they are also stunned for 1.25 seconds and take an additional 165~~0.04~~ damage.

heroic.name: Resurrect
heroic.description:
Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 3 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.

Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

heroic.name: Crystal Aegis
heroic.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255~~0.04~~ damage to all nearby enemies.

heroic.name: Resurrect
heroic.description: After a 3 second delay, you are brought back to life with 100% of maximum Health at the location where you died.

trait.name: Bestow Hope
trait.description:
Passive: 70% of the damage Auriel deals to Heroes and 35% dealt to non-Heroes is stored as energy.

Bestow an allied Hero with Hope. While they remain near Auriel, 30% of their damage to Heroes and 10% of their damage to non-Heroes is converted to energy. Auriel can only have Bestow Hope on 1 ally at a time.

Auriel can store up to 475~~0.04~~ energy.

activable.name: Angelic Flight
activable.description: After 2 seconds, fly to a target location.

activable.name: Shield of Hope
activable.description: Activate to grant all nearby allied Heroes a shield for 3 seconds equal to 50% of the amount of Health they are missing.

level1.name: Increasing Clarity
level1.description:
Quest: Every time Sacred Sweep hits a Hero in the center, increase the center damage by 2, up to 50. 

Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, this center damage bonus is increased to 180.

level1.name: Righteous Assault
level1.description: Reduces the cooldown of Sacred Sweep by 3 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by its center.

level1.name: Searing Light
level1.description: Ray of Heaven also deals damage to enemy Heroes in the area equal to 30% of the energy consumed.

level4.name: Majestic Span
level4.description: Increases the radius of Sacred Sweep by 15%.

level4.name: Heavy Burden
level4.description:
Detainment Strike Slows enemy Heroes by 20% for 2.5 seconds. Slow amount and duration doubled on enemies it Stuns.

Passive: Increase Detainment Strikes' Stun duration by 0.25 seconds.

level4.name: Repeated Offense
level4.description:
Enemies hit by Detainment Strike are knocked back 30% farther.

Quest: Every time Detainment Strike stuns a Hero, increase the stun damage by 10, up to 60.

Reward: After stunning 6 Heroes, increase this damage bonus to 250.

level7.name: Glimmer of Hope
level7.description: Collecting a Regeneration Globe reduces the cost of Auriel's next Ray of Heaven by 75%.

level7.name: Empathic Link
level7.description: Auriel stores 25% of damage taken by allies with Bestow Hope.

level7.name: Energized Cord
level7.description:
Increases the energy stored from Auriel's Basic Attacks to 130% of the damage against Heroes and 70% of the damage against non-Heroes.

Does not affect Auriel's Bestow Hope ally.

Passive: Increase Basic Attack Range by 1.1.

level10.name: Resurrect
level10.description:
Channel on the spirit of a dead ally for 1 second. After a 3 second delay, they are brought back to life with 100% of their maximum Health at the location where they died.

Auriel can use this ability while dead to resurrect herself.

level10.name: Crystal Aegis
level10.description: Place an allied Hero into Stasis for 2 seconds. Upon expiration, Crystal Aegis deals 255~~0.04~~ damage to all nearby enemies.

level13.name: Blinding Flash
level13.description: Enemies hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep are blinded for 2 seconds.

level13.name: Converging Force
level13.description: Enemies hit by the outer area are pushed slightly toward the center.

level13.name: Piercing Lash
level13.description: Detainment Strike now pierces and hits all enemy Heroes in a line, reducing the cooldown by 2 seconds for each Hero hit.

level16.name: Reservoir of Hope
level16.description: Quest: Each maximum energy Ray of Heaven Auriel casts increases the maximum amount of energy that can be stored by 55.

level16.name: Will of Heaven
level16.description:
Allies with Bestow Hope gain 20% Attack Speed.

Passive: Auriel gains 10% increased Basic Attack Damage.

level16.name: Wrath of Heaven
level16.description:
Allies with Bestow Hope gain 15% Spell Power.

Enemy Heroes hit by the center area of Sacred Sweep or the terrain collision of Detainment Strike have their Spell Armor reduced by 20 for 3 seconds.

level20.name: Light Speed
level20.description: Resurrected allies gain 200% increased Movement Speed, decaying over 4 seconds. While a resurrected ally remains alive, Resurrect's next cooldown recharges 100% faster.

level20.name: Diamond Resolve
level20.description: When Crystal Aegis expires, it grants the target 75 Armor for 5 seconds, reducing damage taken by 75%.

level20.name: Angelic Flight
level20.description: After 2 seconds, fly to a target location.

level20.name: Shield of Hope
level20.description: Activate to grant all nearby allied Heroes a shield for 3 seconds equal to 50% of the amount of Health they are missing.
